how to have beauty and brains
(because we don't gatekeep here)

watch the way you speak

speak slower, in clear sentences.
a calm voice says more
than any accessory.

read 10 pages a day

in a few months you'll finish
more books than you thought.

ask good questions

smart people don't know everything.
they know how to ask
"why?" and "how?".

get enough sleep

the simplest beauty secret,
and it helps your brain keep
what you learned.

go to a museum alone

pick one room and look slowly.
you'll see details
others miss.

learn something new
every evening

a painting, a story from history,
a strange fact. 5 minutes
is enough.
